_README: Per-firm layer. retirementtpa.json is the reference send for the retirement TPA sector; duplicate as data/companies/[slug].json for each new firm. Routes /[slug] and /pe/[slug] are generated automatically. Sector scaffold: data/sectors/retirement-tpa.json (shared by all firms in this sector).
_templateMode: true = render amber 'customize' tags on every per-firm slot (for internal review). SET FALSE BEFORE SENDING.
name: Sample Pension Group
_name: [CUSTOMIZE] Recipient firm's name, exactly as they write it.
_plansFte: [CUSTOMIZE] plans = Form-5500 preparer pull; fte = LinkedIn/Apollo headcount. These public numbers size their dot on Graph B only. Do not add firm-specific observations we cannot verify.

peState._sponsorName: [CUSTOMIZE, PE VARIANT ONLY] Sponsor name for /pe/[slug] framing.
